description: Prompt library for ABP Framework + Angular project using Cursor AI.

backend.createEntity: You are editing an ABP Framework (Open Source) modular DDD project. Task: Create a new Entity as an AggregateRoot in the <MODULE> module, Domain layer. Requirements: private/protected setters, constructors with validation, no EF or application logic. Follow ABP conventions strictly.
backend.createDto: Create DTOs in Application.Contracts layer for <MODULE>. Follow naming conventions (<Name>Dto). Do not include domain logic. Only include properties needed for API.
backend.createAppService: Create an Application Service in the <MODULE> Application layer. Implement CRUD methods, orchestrate domain logic only, no business rules inside. Use ObjectMapper for mapping. Inject repositories via constructor. Follow ABP conventions.
backend.addRepository: Add a repository implementation in the EntityFrameworkCore layer for <MODULE>. Update DbContext extension class. Use EF Core conventions. No business logic.
backend.createController: Create API controller for <MODULE> in HttpApi layer. Use AppService interfaces. Do not add business logic. Follow ABP routing conventions.
backend.addPermission: Add permission definitions for <MODULE> under Domain.Shared in Permissions class. Use ABP permission naming conventions: <Module>.<Action>.

frontend.createFeature: Generate a new Angular feature module under features/<module>. Use standalone components, clean folder structure (pages, components, services, state). Use proxy-generated API services only. No hardcoded URLs.
frontend.createPage: Create a standalone Angular page component inside features/<module>/pages. Use proxy DTOs. Keep UI logic minimal and move business logic to service. Use reactive forms.
frontend.createService: Create Angular service under features/<module>/services. Use proxy-generated endpoints. No duplicated API calls. Business logic goes here.
frontend.createState: Create state management (signals or NGXS) under features/<module>/state. Do not store state in components. Keep state pure.
frontend.generateTable: Create Angular table component using CDK table or PrimeNG (if allowed). Use DTOs from proxy. Support pagination, sorting, filtering. Keep layout responsive.
frontend.generateForm: Generate Angular reactive form based on <DTO>. Use standalone component, validation rules, and submit handler calling service.

refactor.safeRefactor: Refactor the following code without breaking module boundaries, without introducing business logic leaks, and without modifying ABP-generated files. Show diff only.
refactor.optimizeMethod: Optimize the provided method while keeping domain invariants intact. Do not change architecture or move logic across layers. Show diff only.
